# #587 — Langfuse release is null on every deployed trace: resolver shells git rev-parse but the deployed runtime is a gitless archive

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: bug
Created: 2026-08-05T21:51:04Z
Updated: 2026-08-05T21:51:04Z

---

Found live 2026-08-05 while verifying the #560 closure (RUNNING-verified, not inferred).

**Measured:** local dogfood deployed to trunk `a5a1274` with revision proof (pid 23876 → 51594, `/health` reports `"revision":"a5a1274"`). A fresh post-restart traced tool call (`append_session_event`, 21:45:45Z) still shows `release: null` in the Langfuse traces API.

**Root cause (read in deployed source):** the release resolver in `server/observability/langfuse-tracing.ts` shells `git rev-parse --short HEAD` (line 188 in the deployed copy). But `scripts/local-clone-deploy.sh` ships the runtime via `git archive` — deliberately, so the working tree is structurally invisible — which means **the deployed runtime has no `.git` directory at all** (verified: `/Volumes/ThunderBolt/open-brain-local/app/.git` does not exist). `git rev-parse` can never succeed in the deployed shape, the resolver treats unknown-release as omit-and-continue (correct per its own comment: "Not knowing the release is never a reason to lose tracing"), and the result is `release: null` on 100% of deployed traces — the exact field #560's fix shape added so cost changes could be attributed to a build.

The irony: `/health` answers the same question correctly on the same process, because the deploy stamps the revision into the runtime directory and `/health` reads the stamp. The tracing resolver and the health endpoint disagree about whether the build is knowable.

**Fix shape (PROPOSED, ~S):** the release resolver reads the deploy's revision stamp first (same source `/health` uses), falling back to `git rev-parse` for dev-checkout runs where no stamp exists. A test that fails when a stamped-but-gitless runtime yields a null release.

**Why it matters:** release attribution only exists in the environments nobody debugs (dev checkouts) and is absent in the ones everybody debugs (deployed dogfood, core01 — which deploys the same `git archive` way via the core01 script this one mirrors).
